name: banking_support
provenance: Public BANKING77 online banking queries and original intent annotations from PolyAI. A fixed three-intent support-routing task selected before evaluation; not all 77 intents, and not live customer traffic collected by this project.

source.authors: Iñigo Casanueva, Tadas Temcinas, Daniela Gerz, Matthew Henderson, Ivan Vulić (2020)

policy.card_arrival: Delivery and arrival of a bank card already ordered.
policy.lost_or_stolen_card: A missing, lost, or stolen card.
policy.scope: Only these three original BANKING77 intents. Other requests are outside this measured task.

protocol: All official test rows for the three preselected intents are evaluation only. Within official train, normalized word-token duplicates stay together; SHA-256 of the normalized prompt orders groups within each intent, and the first 30% of groups form calibration. No model or parameter selection uses official test outcomes.
